lines.en: Ahh, the dorms — that magical location that feels more like the Backrooms than a safe place for girls to hang out and masturbate sometimes.
Which isn’t to say you can’t masturbate in the Backrooms. You probably can. And it would probably be awesome. But it would also probably be scary. Which is also what the dorms are like. Maybe. Scary.

Or at least scary-adjacent. Because, when you sit down and think about nightmares or sorrow or any of the other negative stuff you’ve come to associate with this game, the greatest concentration of it has occurred within these walls.
There are twenty girls in here. Not right now, but as a whole. Sometimes even more when the world breaks. And each one of them has their own troubles, trials, and tribadism. Err...tribulations.
Sorry, just thinking about masturbating again. And how negative emotions aren’t the only thing highly concentrated here since puberty is a violent beast.
Right now, no one was masturbating. Sad. And no one was really thinking about it either.
Except for me, of course. But that doesn’t mean much since I’m not Akira Arakawa.
In fact, I’m not really here at all! And selecting the dorms today was just the trigger you needed to activate a completely unrelated event! Congratulations!
Here’s more melancholy.
: Hm? Coming! One sec!
: Uhhhhhhhh...
: H...Heeeey...
: Well, this is...not something that has ever happened before.
: Is this weird? This is definitely weird. It is, right?
: The...the flowers? No, they...they seem pretty standard to me. Are they...a gift for Miss Watabe or something?
: I should go. I’m getting college flashbacks right now. Sorry for suddenly knowing where you live.
: Miss Osaka, what’s going on? What are you doing here? And why are you asking me about flowers?
: I’m not. This is all a dream. I was never actually here and, in a few minutes, you’re going to wake up and forget all about it.
: Oh. Well...okay then? Not very believable given what my dreams have been like lately, but I guess nice surprises aren’t ever really out of the question.
: So do I just...lie back down or-
: Oh, God fucking damn it.
: The flowers are for you, not Wakana. A friend of mine got me into the habit of trying to cheer people up with gifts and, without beating around the bush, I think you might...need that.
: Need...to be cheered up? Why? I’m fine.
: Cool. Well, they’re non-refundable, so I think you should take them anyway. And, in the event that you stop feeling fine, look at them and remember someone cares.
: Or just let them die. That’s fine too. They were kind of cheap, to be honest. I got them from the convenience store.
: I should go.
: Oh...okay. We’re hugging now. That’s a thing I expected to happen.
: Thank you...I needed this.
: Yeah, of course. You don’t need to thank me. Just...talk to me. If you want to, I mean. It’s just...pretending to be okay isn’t going to help you at all and I’ve been really worried lately.
: I don’t know how to talk about it, that’s the problem.
: Is it really that? Or is it just...not having someone to talk to?
: A little of both I guess...I can talk to Sensei, but you know how he is. There’s Sara too but that doesn’t feel right either. And all my friends are just...
: Wait, how do you even know where I live? I’ve never told you my address or room number.
: Akira told me after I asked him what was going on with you. And don’t give me too much credit for coming since he was the one who ultimately pushed me to do this.
: Oh...so you didn’t really want to-
: No! No, no, no. Not like that. I just...you know...I’m your karate instructor. We’re not, like...close or...you know, right? Like, its probably weird for me to chase you down to...do stuff.
: It’s not weird...
: It’s...it’s not?
: I don’t think so. And Sensei didn’t either if he told you to come. So why do you seem so nervous right now?
: That’s...uhh...
: Are you attracted to me, Miss Osaka? What will Miss Watabe think?
: Okay, now you’re just acting like him. Show me you know better than that, please.
: MMMMHNGHMNMHMNMHMM!!!
: So, uhh...interesting decor choice you’ve got there.
: Ahh, yes. My collection of Sensei pictures.
: I’m sure he’d let me take more now if I asked him to, but I kind of like the sleeping ones. I think I have a real eye for photography.
: ...Right.
: I have extras if you want any. Framed ones. You won’t even have to go to the store or measure sizes or anything.
: Is now a good time to remind you I’m the only girl in this city that doesn’t want to sleep with him?
: Oh, right. Because you love me instead.
: Ayane, do you want to tell me what’s going on? And by “do you want to?” what I really mean is “can I pester you into telling me?” since I know you won’t do it on your own.
: I do, I just...it’s hard. And not just because I’m already bad at doing that. I just feel kind of...empty.
: Liiiiiike...depression?
: I mean, I’m definitely depressed...but I don’t have depression.
: This is different. Like...that feeling you get when you hop off of a train and keep thinking that you accidentally left something behind.
: I get it. Just, when I feel that way, it’s normally because I did forget something.
: It’s possible I did too. I just can’t remember what. And so now, every second that goes by, I’m trying to figure out what that something is.
: But the weirdest part is that I feel like I’ve felt this way before. That I’ve had this exact conversation before. Just with someone else where you are now.
: Well, what did they do? Because the only counseling experience I have is through Akira and Wakana and the two of them are stubborn as fuck and refuse to actually listen.
: I don’t know...I guess I must have figured it out if those feelings eventually went away. Things just feel kind of different this time.
: Like...kind of like how I just forgot how to actually be happy in general. To the point where even thinking about happiness makes me feel kind of...guilty, I guess?
: So, in a sense, you’re lacking something that makes you feel whole.
: Yeah...does that make sense?
: Of course. I’m the same way too, you know. Just with purpose as a concept instead of some vague article or idea I can’t remember.
: Really? You’ve always seemed so cool to me, though.
: Thanks. You’re probably not very hard to impress though if that fuckin’ oaf of a teacher managed to win your heart to the point of you snapping photos of him in his sleep.
: Yeah, well...hearts can be kind of vulnerable and easy to snatch up if you get the timing right.
: And Sensei was there for me when my parents weren’t. So everything after that was just falling.
: How very romantic and not at all creepy.
: I know how it sounds. But he really didn’t spend long in the “dad” role before I started to see him as something more.
: The time he did spend in it, though?...I think you’d be surprised to see just how well he did. He can be pretty amazing when he actually tries to be. He just...doesn’t.
: But what’s weird is that even that thought makes me sad now when it used to make me feel so comfortable.
: Like all the things that brought me joy are gone. And all that’s left is the faint sound of birds in the back of my mind.
: How long will it be until they sing something happy, I wonder?
: Jesus. Wakana would have loved that.
: Sorry, I...that’s just...how it’s been lately. I’m...kind of a wreck. Hahah...
: Well, what can I do?
: Huh?
: To make you feel better. Which isn’t to say I expect to just magically cure you of sadness. But there’s gotta be something, right? Even if it’s small.
: Something tells me, you’ve already done as much as you can.
: Huh...Well, then either you really like flowers or I’m even less cut out for this than I thought.
: I think I just really like flowers. And I think you should stop doubting yourself.
: Noted. I’ll get on that as soon as you remember what it is you’re looking for.
: I think I’ll be looking for a very long time.
: Don’t forget to pack a lunch then. And let me know when you find it.
: I will, Miss Osaka. I promise.
: You know I don’t mind if you call me Osako, right? Think it’s pretty clear I’ve moved out of the “just a teacher” role now that I’m in your bedroom.
: Right, sorry. I’ve only just started calling Sensei by his real name, so...maybe I’m just slow with that?
: Nothing wrong with being slow. Especially with how quickly life tries to backhand you sometimes. Patience gives you a little more breathing room between all the pain.
: That statement implies that there would be no pain within the breathing room and I have discovered lately that things are quite the opposite.
: Nice. All I’ve discovered lately is that my favorite student has become just as cynical and miserable as the guy who should be raising her instead of romancing her.
: If we want to get technical, my real dad is the one who should be doing that. He’s too busy with bubblewrap, though.
: Oh, right. I forget he’s not dead sometimes.
: Can you teach me how to think he is?
: Probably not. But I could give you a crash course on how to make your family think you are. And all you need is a closet.
: Oof.
: Just a little joke. My parents have always accepted me. Always knew it too. Can’t say the same for extended family but, hey — that’s just how it goes sometimes.
: Do you want any kids, Miss...uh...sorry...Osako?
: Me? There’s no way I could be a mom. I’m horrible with kids.
: That’s not what I asked, though. You can be horrible with them and still want them.
: Sure, I guess. It’s just a much harder task for people like me.
: Rin’s moms did it, didn’t they? And you’re friends with the one in our school, right? Maybe she could give you tips or something?
: It’s honestly a miracle anyone trusted a child in the hands of that woman. She seems like a good mom all things considered, though.
: I think you’d be a good mom, too.
: Me? Who needed to be convinced to just come talk to you? Thanks, but no. I’m not cut out for something like that. You need confidence to be a mother and I just...don’t have that. At all.
: But confidence is something you can develop. And, for all you know, the you five years from now might be unrecognizable from the you you are now.
: Again, maybe. But that’s still not taking into account just how drastically a child would change my life. And that’s not even touching on how Wakana feels.
: I don’t even know how you feel yet, though. You keep deflecting the question with different potential obstacles.
: It’s not an easy question, Ayane. Not everyone is born like you. Someone who just knows they want to be a mother one day.
: Sorry, I...I wasn’t trying to offend you or anything...
: I’m not offended, it’s just...
: It’s not something I grew up thinking...would ever really happen. Like....going on a trip to Hawaii or something. Just...way more dramatic and scary than that.
: So...a dream.
: Or lack thereof? Like, sure...poor people can dream about Hawaii too. But it’s not like they ever expect it to actually happen.
: But...they want it to happen. And you still won’t even say that.
: Osako-
: Ayane, I am not the biggest fan of myself. And I am not interested in subjecting a child to a me who can’t even figure out who or what she is yet.
: I’m a lesbian. I’m young. I live in a small apartment. Wakana and I are both extremely busy. We don’t have the time or energy for a dog, let alone a kid.
: We have to think about ourselves before anyone else. And besides, Wakana hates children with a burning passion. She can barely tolerate you guys and you’re not even that much younger than us.
: She’d never agree to this. She’d be signing her life away, and I don’t blame her for that at all.
: Okay...but...
: But in a perfect world...
: Where none of that is true...
: Where it’s no longer impossible...
: I should probably go. But you can text me if you need me, okay? And I hope you feel at least...slightly better soon. Sad Ayane sucks.
: I’m sorry...I didn’t realize bringing this up would be difficult for you. Can I just...say one last thing, though?
: You probably shouldn’t, but...fine.
: If you do want to be a mom...but Miss Watabe doesn’t...maybe you two are-
: Actually, on second thought, I don’t think I should hear this. But uhhhh...texts. Together. Do it. Yeah.
: Yeah...
: Goodnight, Ayane. Sorry I’m...
: Yeah.
: Thank you for the flowers...
